remarks:
Welcome to 9929 Skyline Drive in Machias, where spectacular views of Lime Lake and the rolling hills of Cattaraugus County are yours to enjoy every day! From the moment you pull into the driveway, the elevated setting and panoramic views make an impression that only gets better as you explore this property. Whether you're searching for a year-round residence, weekend getaway or potential short-term rental investment, this home offers something special.

The outdoor living spaces are the centerpiece of this property. An expansive deck with vinyl railings overlooks Lime Lake and the surrounding countryside, while the inground pool and newly poured two-tiered concrete patio provide multiple areas for relaxing and entertaining, all with incredible views. Improvements include a new poured retaining wall with drainage, new stairs, updated pool mechanicals and a new liner, creating your own private resort overlooking the lake.

Inside, the views continue to impress! The living room features a stone fireplace with a newer wood-burning insert, shiplap-style ceilings and windows overlooking the lake and hills. The dining area offers another outstanding vantage point, while the kitchen has wonderful country charm with beautiful cabinetry, stainless steel appliances and a warm, welcoming feel. Newer laminate flooring runs throughout the first floor, and the remodeled bathroom in 2026 features beautiful tilework and modern finishes. The bedrooms also feature shiplap-style ceilings.

The finished walkout basement adds living and entertaining space with an open layout, bar area, newer flooring and a bonus room that could potentially serve as a third bedroom or home office. A convenient half bath serves the lower level and pool area, while the adjoining three-season room overlooks the pool and lake.

Additional improvements include a new steel roof in 2025, new septic tank in 2026 and newer mini-split A/C. The property also features a blacktop driveway. With Lime Lake just below and panoramic countryside views in nearly every direction, 9929 Skyline Drive offers an incredible combination of scenery, outdoor living and year-round enjoyment!
